adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` to an array and adds logic in `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` to iterate over multiple destination calendars and create events per destination/credential. However, `Office365CalendarService.createEvent` now always uses only the first entry via `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? [];` and builds the events URL from that (`/me/calendars/${mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId}/events`). There is no selection by `credentialId` (unlike the updated Google integration), so when `event.destinationCalendar` contains multiple entries, Office365 will keep targeting the first calendar regardless of which credential is being used for that create call, leading to wrong-calendar inserts or 404s.
